disabled.__transform:
$not(
  $components.Form37.data.mergeAll = true
  or
  (
    $components.Form37.data.mergeAll = false
    and
    $components.Form37.data.mergeQuantity > 0
  )
  or
  (
    $isNilOrEmpty($components.Form35.data.number)~>$not
    and
    $isNilOrEmpty($components.Form33.data.number)~>$not
  )
  or
  $not(
    $components.Form35.data.number = $components.Form33.data.number
  )
)
